maria: FYI ran the Go SDK sample app onboarding today. Repro: cancelling a generator stream while the SDK is doing a token refresh leaves goroutines dangling.

sam: hmm, does the refresh block the stream iterator? any snippet?

maria: yeah, it's in the sampleapp auth code. pattern is basically: 
```
for resp.Next() {
  if provider.NeedsRefresh() {
    provider.Refresh() // blocking network call
  }
  process(resp.Event())
}
```
If ctx.Cancel() fires during Refresh() generator doesn't return, Next() blocks forever.

ci-bot: CI alert: flaky test stream-cancel-integration failed 2x on main; goroutine leak observed in trace - https://ci.internal/job/stream-cancel/

ina: (cc @ina) One quick fix is making Refresh(ctx) accept a context and doing the refresh with select on ctx.Done(). That way cancellation can interrupt the refresh.

ina: Also ensure the generator iterator Close()/Cancel() triggers closing the underlying http.Stream or request body. The current iterator only toggles an internal flag.

raj: I'll prototype TokenProviderWithContext, update sampleapp to call provider.Refresh(ctx) inside a goroutine and select on either refresh result or ctx.Done(), then surface a cancel path that closes the http response body.

olivia: Good plan. Let's also add a small unit/integration test that spins up a fake streaming server, starts Generate(), then cancels after a couple of tokens and asserts goroutine count remains stable.

sam: For SDK parity: JS already has an async token callback example in quickstart. We should port the pattern to Go and include a helper in the SDK (TokenProviderWithContext) + example code in examples/streaming.

maria: I'll open an issue with repro steps and attach heap/goroutine dumps. Attaching a short reproduction gist in the issue will help devs run locally.

raj: PR coming soon. planning to: update sampleapp, add TokenProviderWithContext helper, add streaming cancel test, and doc note in quickstart about stream cancellation + auth.

olivia: After PR lands, update docs/streaming.md and the onboarding guide to highlight the non-blocking token pattern. Could also add a Note in the generator README about Close() semantics.

maria: thanks everyone. this one bit a customer during onboarding so higher priority.
